title: Data Engineer (French client)
adText: We are hiring a data engineer for a French retail client based in Lyon. You will build and run the client's data pipelines from our Port Louis office (hybrid). Required: at least 3 years of data engineering experience, Python and SQL. A plus: Apache Airflow, a cloud data platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), Docker, and experience working directly with clients. The client calls in French from the first week.

job.summary: Data engineer for a French retail client: builds and runs Python/SQL pipelines, talks to the client in French from week one.
